title: Terms of Use
description: Public website terms of use for the Upstream Atlas website.
statusLine: Status: Final approved text pending publication
noticeBody: This page exists so the public website can route users to the correct canonical legal URL. It is not yet the final published Terms of Use text.
statusItems: Canonical public URL reserved for the website Terms of Use.
Final approved text will replace this notice without changing the page URL.
For the current approved wording, contact the Upstream Atlas team directly.

sections.heading: Why this page exists
paragraphs: Upstream Atlas is preparing a formal public website Terms of Use document for this canonical URL.
Until the approved text is ready, this placeholder page makes the legal navigation path stable and avoids sending users to an error page.

sections.heading: What happens next
paragraphs: Once the final wording is approved, this page will be replaced in place with the official Terms of Use content.
The URL will remain unchanged so footer links, bookmarks, and search results continue to resolve correctly.
